slides.title: Gemini 3 Google Gemini 3 released November 17
slides.text: Gemini 3 Google Gemini 3 released November 17 https://deepmind.google/models/gemini/ https://www.youtube.com/@googledeepmind - many videos https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=96qyyz_ZJ_U https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W8HeSP_JJQc It tops the LMArena leaderboard with a score of 1501, dethroning Grok-4.1 which had held the position for less than 24 hours. It ranks first across all categories (text, web dev, vision, coding, math, creative writing, and instruction following) Multimodal processing - natively handling text, images, video, audio, and code simultaneously rather than processing them separately. The model achieves PhD-level reasoning with 91.9% on GPQA Diamond and 37.5% on Humanity's Last Exam without tools. For multimodal tasks, it scores 81% on MMMU-Pro and 87.6% on Video-MMMU, along with 72.1% on SimpleQA Verified for factual accuracy Gemini 3 Deep Think mode offers enhanced reasoning for complex problems, achieving very high scores on Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, and ARC-AGI-2 The model includes improved spatial reasoning for embodied tasks like pointing and trajectory prediction, unlocking applications in autonomous vehicles, XR devices, and robotics 1 Mln context window, 64K tokens output, knowledge cutoff Jan 2025 Gemini 3 is available through Google Search, the Gemini app, AI Studio, Vertex AI, and developer tools including Cursor, GitHub, JetBrains, and Cline. Pro and Ultra subscribers in the US can access it now, with Deep Think mode rolling out to Ultra subscribers in the coming weeks Google Antigravity - Google's new agentic development platform Download the app for Mac, Windows, Linux Task-oriented, autonomous software development IDE Uses Gemini 3's advanced reasoning, tool use, and agentic coding capabilities to function as an active development partner rather than just an assistance tool The platform features agents with dedicated access to the editor, terminal, and browser, allowing them to autonomously plan and execute complex end-to-end software tasks while validating their own code Developers act as architects collaborating with intelligent agents that handle building features, UI iteration, bug fixes, research, and report generation. Google Antigravity comes bundled with Gemini 3 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model for browser control, and Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Image) for image editing . Public preview is available for free download on macOS, Windows, and Linux https://antigravity.google/ https://www.youtube.com/@googleantigravity

slides.title: Gemini 3 - continued Gemini 3 can generate
slides.text: Gemini 3 - continued Gemini 3 can generate sophisticated and highly customized interactive 3D applications—including games, visualizations, and simulations—based solely on prompts, images, or simple inputs https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Aslkp6J-EdE Spatial and Visual Reasoning - creating spatially aware scenes, 3D editors (such as LEGO-like environments), and even unique artistic visualizations that blend biological and synthetic concepts Gemini 3 Pro is the first language model to outperform professional human players at GeoGuessr (browser-based geography game in which players try to deduce locations from Google Street View imagery) Scientific and Educational Visualizations - interactive black hole simulations with real-time scientific visualizations and quizzes "Deep Think" can synthesize mind-bending philosophical ideas (e.g., the notion that humans only perceive a utility-optimized user interface, not objective reality, echoing contemporary theories in cognitive science) Competence in practical applications such as sign language recognition via webcam, and building “Jarvis”-like interfaces for personal productivity Gemini 3 is now considered the best-performing AI model globally https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dtBvh1nIAM4 Gemini 3 has surged to the top of independent benchmarks, outperforming rivals like GPT-5.1 by a significant margin Pricing: Gemini 3 Flash Gemini 3 Pro $2/$12 per 1Mt in/out (for under 200K tokens) Gemini 3 Pro $4/$18 per 1Mt in/out (for more than 200K tokens) Gemini 3 Deep Think (Reasoning) Gemini 3 Pro Personal $20/mo Gemini 3 Ultra $250/mo Model size estimated ~ 3T params total. It is a sparse MoE Gemini 3 is praised for its agentic coding abilities, multimodal reasoning, and fast inference speeds (128 tokens per second). It can handle complex, multi-step tasks autonomously, such as generating code for a 3D nuclear power plant simulator in just a few prompts High token efficiency "Anti-Gravity," a new AI-powered coding IDE based on a VS Code fork. Anti-Gravity is widely seen as a rebranded version of Windsurf, a popular AI coding tool whose IP and top talent were acquired by Google The platform retains some remnants of Windsurf's codebase, such as the "Cascade" agent name, which was missed during the rebranding Google's position in the AI race is now seen as dominant. The company benefits from its massive user base, custom TPU silicon, and integrated hardware/software stack Mervin Praison - comparing Gemini 3 with Claude Sonnet 4.5 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-ntV1CsqxgY Gemini 3 Pro has a significant advantage in speed, producing smoother animations with fewer warnings; Claude Sonnet 4.5 offers superior visual quality with more natural-looking terrains, enhanced shadows, and detailed aesthetics Testing projects ranged from rotating cube simulations, data-driven dashboards, molecular explorers, product configurators, to city generators and particle systems.

slides.title: Grok 4.1 Grok 4.1 claimed the #1 position
slides.text: Grok 4.1 Grok 4.1 claimed the #1 position on the LM Arena leaderboard surpassing Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro Released on November 17, 2025 (was silently rolled out for 2 weeks) Achieves exceptional rankings across multiple benchmarks Reduced hallucination (via massive RL compute - hallucination rate dropped from 12.09% to 4.22%) xAI developed new methods using "frontier agentic reasoning models as reward models to autonomously evaluate and iterate on responses at scale". This represents AI-judged reinforcement learning (RLHF's AI equivalent) where one model evaluates another's subjective outputs like poetry or emotional responses Better creative writing, richer storytelling, stronger coherence, and more vivid prose compared to previous versions. Response quality is more concise and focused, eliminating the verbose "blabber" Native multimodal generation, automatically outputting images, tables, and structured content as part of natural conversations Good coding abilities, but still lags behind Claude Sonnet 3.5 and GPT The model successfully solved complex logical reasoning puzzles, including the "Three Gods" riddle requiring self-referential questions and deduction through uncertainty Grok 4.1 is available to all users, including free tier accounts, through grok.com and mobile apps for iOS and Android. Free users receive 10 requests per 2 hours https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z5ulfaRTI1s https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wIR6tRlxgp4 https://x.ai/news/grok-4-1 Grok-5 release is planned for Q1 2026. 6 Trillion params, double the size of Grok-4 3 Trillion params. slides.title: GPT 5.1 GPT-5.1 Faster (adaptive) reasoning. GPT-5.1 adjusts
slides.text: GPT 5.1 GPT-5.1 Faster (adaptive) reasoning. GPT-5.1 adjusts its thinking time based on task complexity. It’s noticeably faster on everyday tasks while staying deep and rigorous on harder ones. And when you need maximum speed, you can set reasoning_effort='none' Better coding performance - cleaner, more reliable code with stronger step-by-step reasoning. It’s better at refactoring, debugging, UI generation, and quick-iteration workflows—while avoiding unnecessary overthinking on simple edits Codex Models: gpt-5.1-codex and gpt-5.1-codex-mini gpt-5.1: for everyday coding tasks gpt-5.1-codex: for complex, long-running agentic coding gpt-5.1-codex-mini: for cost-efficient edits and changes GPT-5.1 unlocks a faster, more reliable building experience. Perplexity Update Now users can create, edit, and manage slides, spreadsheets, and documents directly within the Perplexity search interface Available only to paid users (Pro & Max) and only on web (not mobile) Users can research topics and immediately generate ready-to-use assets—such as presentations, business reports, or operational documents—without switching to external applications like Google Slides or Microsoft Office Real-time editing with AI suggestions that proactively recommend asset types or improvements based on the nature of the research Business reporting: Instantly format industry data into slides or reports.[1] Marketing analysis: Organize campaign data into spreadsheets and presentation-ready formats Operational planning: Generate documents with action items and timelines based on real-time research Share/export assets easily https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CqJmLsj25K4 Perplexity Update

slides.title: AI Updates - 1 China photonic quantum chip
slides.text: AI Updates - 1 China photonic quantum chip https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OA02eRm11JU Claims 1000x speed boost over NVIDIA GPUs for specific AI jobs The chip was developed jointly by CHIPX (Chip Hub for Integrated Photonics Xplore), a Wuxi-based institute affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Turing Quantum, a Shanghai-based startup The Chip uses photons (light) as information carriers rather than electrical signals; has 1K+ optical components in a single 6-inch thin-film lithium niobate wafer using a monolithic design Electronic and photonic components on the same wafer CHIPX has established China's first pilot production line for 12K wafers per year. Each wafer yielding approximately 350 chips The chip is already being used across aerospace, biomedicine, and finance sectors, providing computational capabilities that exceed classical computer limits for specific problem types The developers describe this as the 1st  "industrial-grade" optical quantum chip, indicating a shift from laboratory prototypes to production-ready data center hardware Anthropic 30 Bln deals with Microsoft & NVIDIA Anthropic committed to $30 Bln in compute spend on Azure and NVIDIA GPUs Microsoft and NVIDIA will invest up to $5 Bln and $10 Bln, respectively, in Anthropic This deal integrates Anthropic's Claude models into Azure and Microsoft products, providing customers with increased AI model choice.

slides.title: Serena open-source AI coding toolkit Serena open-source AI
slides.text: Serena open-source AI coding toolkit Serena open-source AI coding toolkit https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KeXmXYAaUU4 - video demo https://github.com/oraios/serena https://www.everydev.ai/tools/serena Serena transforms LLMs and coding agents from basic code generators into sophisticated assistants with IDE-grade capabilities Instead of scanning entire files or performing simple text searches, Serena enables AI agents to use code-centric tools like finding symbols, locating references, and making context-aware edits It leverages the Language Server Protocol (LSP) to provide semantic analysis across 30+ programming languages including Python, JavaScript, and many others Unlike spec-driven frameworks such as BMAD, SpecKit, and OpenSpec - which focus on planning and structuring tasks - Serena specializes in providing semantic code intelligence While those tools help agents plan workflows, Serena gives agents the ability to understand code symbols, navigate real codebases, and make precise edits with IDE-grade accuracy Serena complements spec-driven frameworks by handling the actual code editing portion Serena works through the MCP server and integrates with multiple platforms including Claude Desktop, VSCode, Cursor, IDEs, and extensions like Cline You can install it locally using UV and Git, through Docker (experimental), or most easily via MCP server configuration. The video demonstrates it working with Cilo Code (Kilo Code), where the agent successfully performed semantic searches across a large codebase and added methods to application classes efficiently

slides.title: DeepMind SIMA 2 Research Preview DeepMind SIMA 2
slides.text: DeepMind SIMA 2 Research Preview DeepMind SIMA 2 Research Preview SIMA 2 is a AI agent that plays video games by observing the screen and using keyboard/mouse controls just like humans do Skills can potentially transfer to physical robots Task completion rates jumped from 31% (SIMA 1) to 65% (SIMA 2), approaching the 76% human benchmark The agent now handles unseen game environments with 13-14% success rates versus near-zero previously It understands complex instructions, reasons about goals, follows multi-step commands, and interprets ambiguous requests like "go to the tomato house" by correctly inferring the user meant the red building SIMA 2 uses Gemini 2.5 flash-lite in three simultaneous roles: playing the game, setting tasks, and grading performance This creates an autonomous learning cycle where the AI generates its own training data through self-directed play, eliminating the need for additional human-labeled datasets. The system learns exclusively through trial-and-error in new environments SIMA-2 can be combined with Genie-3 (a model that generates playable 3D environments from text and images) . SIMA-2 navigates and completes tasks in these procedurally generated environments it has never encountered, with world memory ensuring objects and changes persist across sessions https://deepmind.google/blog/sima-2-an-agent-that-plays-reasons-and-learns-with-you-in-virtual-3d-worlds/ The agent can transfer concepts between completely different games. Skills learned from mining in Minecraft apply to harvesting in Viking survival games SIMA 2's core capabilities - navigation, tool use, instruction following, collaborative task execution - are fundamental building blocks for embodied intelligence - robots The pixel-to-action learning paradigm maps directly to robots processing sensor data and controlling physical components. Virtual worlds provide safe, scalable training environments that eliminate expensive real-world datasets and dangerous physical training. Limitations: restricted memory and context windows to maintain low-latency interactions, difficulties with long-horizon tasks, and challenges in complex 3D navigation

slides.text: AI Updates 2 "Flows" - in Google Workspace - new no-code AI automation platform Automate workflows across Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Chat, and Forms using natural language instructions. Users can create AI agents that can research, analyze, summarize, and generate content while triggering multi-step processes across an organization Starters (triggers), conditions, actions, functions Users can either describe tasks in plain English to have Gemini build the automation, or use a drag-and-drop visual builder similar to platforms like Make or Zapier What sets Flows apart is its deep integration with Google's AI, providing contextual understanding that goes beyond simply running steps https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UACj1WqXU2Q https://sites.google.com/view/workspace-flows/about Example: automating email notifications from key contacts, extracting and summarizing email content about specific topics, and sending summaries to Google Chat. Example: creating a lead enrichment agent: automatically processes incoming leads from forms or emails, uses Gemini to research the company, scores the lead quality, extracts contact details, and updates a sales CRM sheet - all configured in under 30 sec Anthropic Disrupting AI-orchestrated cyber espionage campaign https://assets.anthropic.com/m/ec212e6566a0d47/original/Disrupting-the-first-reported-AI-orchestrated-cyber-espionage-campaign.pdf U.S. must back open-source AI Databricks Co-Founder Urges Open AI Race: Ali Ghodsi argues the U.S. must back open-source AI to stay ahead of China. slides.title: AI Updates 5 Google's Gemini CLI updates interactive
slides.text: AI Updates 5 Google's Gemini CLI updates interactive shell support, redesigned UI, custom command automation PTY (pseudo-terminal) support - run terminal commands like vim, htop, and git rebase directly inside Gemini CLI without switching contexts Better UI - flicker-free display, sticky headers, stable input prompt at the bottom, mouse support, preserves your full chat history even when using alternate screen buffers You can now create your own slash commands using TOML files stored in your Gemini commands folder. These commands support variable placeholders using `{{args}}`, can execute shell commands within prompts using `!{...}` syntax, and allow you to namespace commands into organized folders like `/git commit` or `/git review`. This enables one-line automation of repetitive tasks - for example, a `/plan` command for project planning or a `/review` command that analyzes your git diff JSON streaming output for automation, a markdown toggle, arrow key editing for queued messages, improved web fetch for JSON APIs, and the ability to run slash commands non-interactively from scripts The CLI is open source: npm install -g @google/gemini-cli https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8K_V2oTUXtc Running AlphaFold on your Mac using MLX Framework https://latentspacecraft.com/posts/mlx-protein-folding This is alternative to running on Linux with Nvidia (32-64GB system memory + 12-80GB GPU) Google WeatherNext 2 Forecasting Model Global forecasts 8x faster and at hourly resolution Outperforms the prior version on 99.9% of variables

slides.text: AI Updates 6 Intuit $100 Mln/year  deal with OpenAI A multi-year deal to pay OpenAI over $100 Mln annually to integrate ChatGPT models across TurboTax, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp DeepSeek R1 Slim - smaller and "de-censored" DeepSeek R1 The scientists at Multiverse Computing, a Spanish firm specializing in quantum-inspired AI techniques, created, a model that is 55% smaller but performs almost as well as the original model Crucially, they also claim to have eliminated official Chinese censorship from the model. The compression technique was inspired by quantum physics that allowed them to identify specific parts of the neural network that could be eliminated without significantly degrading the model's reasoning capabilities.​ The team also was able to identify and remove parts of the model specifically tied to politically sensitive filtering and censorship rules embedded in Chinese AI systems The compression appears to be structural pruning rather than quantization https://www.technologyreview.com/2025/11/19/1128119/quantum-physicists-compress-and-deconsor-deepseekr1/

slides.title: DeepMind DreamerV4 DeepMind new AI achieves Minecraft mastery
slides.text: DeepMind DreamerV4 DeepMind new AI achieves Minecraft mastery with 100x less training data https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bsrXd0loJFM Using an innovative technique called DreamerV4 that learns by imagining scenarios inside a simulated world model, not through direct game experience or extensive labeled video footage The AI was trained with only a small amount of human gameplay footage and did not interact directly with Minecraft It then has built an internal representation (world model) of how Minecraft works, then practiced within that simulated environment using imagination-based learning DreamerV4 operates in three phases: first, it watches videos to build an internal simulation of the game (world model pretraining) Second, it receives instant feedback as it trains inside its imagined world, learning which actions yield rewards and building expectations about valuable strategies Third, it continues practicing in its simulation, replaying millions of imagined scenarios to refine its approach The new model outperforms OpenAI’s Video Pre-Training (VPT), achieving up to 90% success rates on tasks where OpenAI’s approach failed completely DreamerV4 enables the agent to accomplish complex multi-step goals, such as crafting pickaxes and mining diamonds, despite not being exposed to the actual game or large labeled datasets Limitations: The AI’s simulated “dreams” are short and stitched together, so it’s strong at short-term predictions but struggles with long-term Over long runs, small inaccuracies in its model can compound, leading to mistakes The approach demonstrates huge benefits of imagination-driven AI training

slides.title: Google Opal for Automation Opal primarily integrates with
slides.text: Google Opal for Automation Opal primarily integrates with Google services and lacks the extensive third-party ecosystem of its competitors In comparison, Make ( make.com , former Integromat) and Zapier each offer over 3,000 app integrations, while n8n 's open-source nature allows custom connectors. OpenAI & Anthropic do not provide their own pipeline builders, but you can use Microsoft Power Automate which similarly to Opal provides visual workflow automation and can integrate with models from various providers (like OpenAI & Anthropic) Power Automate includes AI-powered flow creation where you describe what you want in natural language and it generates the workflow However, Power Automate focuses primarily on enterprise app integration rather than AI-first application building. Also you need the Microsoft 365 environment How to automate your personal work? Start building with Make (it is free to start), for example: sending meeting notes to Slack; moving email attachments to Drive; turning form responses into reports; syncing data between tools; cleaning information into a sheet; storing information in organized folders; Google Opal - no-code AI application builder Allows users to create, edit, and share AI-powered mini-apps using only natural language descriptions Launched in July 2025, expanded to 160+ countries in November Users simply describe what they want to build in plain English, and Opal automatically generates a node-based workflow diagram showing the logical flow of the application. These workflows can include inputs, AI model calls (using Google's models), and outputs Users can drag and drop elements or make conversational adjustments. The platform has built-in tools like search functions, webpage retrieval, location services, and weather information. Once created, mini-apps can be instantly published and shared via a unique web link, with Opal handling all hosting requirements Common applications: document summarizers, customer support reply generators, marketing copy enhancers, and personal planners. The tool is particularly valuable for rapid prototyping, proofs of concept, and custom productivity tools for non-technical professionals like marketers, salespeople, and business analysts As an experimental beta product, Opal lacks enterprise-grade Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and dedicated support channels Usage costs are based on AI model token consumption (input and output), data storage (around $5 per GiB per month), and advanced features like search grounding (up to $35 per 1,000 requests) https://developers.googleblog.com/en/introducing-opal/ https://developers.google.com/opal An Engineer can use Cline Coding Assistant to write python script to do any type of automation (including AI) - and schedule it. He can also use ETL platforms (Windmill, Apache Airflow, any 100s others). Here we talk about automation that requires no coding

slides.title: TOON = Token-Oriented Object Notation TOON (Token-Oriented Object
slides.text: TOON = Token-Oriented Object Notation TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) Open-source data format that can save you 30-60% on token costs compared to traditional JSON. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfnJXlgpJT0 A new data format designed to drastically reduce the number of tokens used when communicating with AI language models, making API calls faster and cheaper compared to traditional JSON TOON removes the redundant syntax clutter from JSON - no curly braces `{}`, square brackets `[]`, quotation marks, or repeated key names. Instead, it declares field names once at the top (like a table header) and then lists the data rows below, similar to how a CSV file works JSON: { "users": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Alice", "role": "admin" }, { "id": 2, "name": "Bob", "role": "user" } ] } TOON: users[2]{id,name,role}: 1,Alice,admin 2,Bob,user Notice how TOON defines the structure once with users[2]{id,name,role}: (meaning "an array of 2 users with these 3 fields") and then just lists the actual values. No repeated keys like `"id":`, `"name":`, `"role":` for every entry TOON typically uses 30-60% fewer tokens than JSON Response times dropping Better RAG retrieval accuracy Easy to Read Works best for flat, tabular data with many similar objects TOON is not recommended for deeply nested hierarchical data, where the extra indentation and context can actually increase token usage instead of reducing it pip install toon-python npm install toon-format-toon Easily convert to/from JSON

slides.title: Yann LeCun is Leaving Meta Yann LeCun is
slides.text: Yann LeCun is Leaving Meta Yann LeCun is planning to leave Meta in the coming months to launch his own startup focused on world models https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W2tr1Q3D1ZI - good video summary Yann LeCun is widely recognized as one of the "Godfathers of AI" for his pioneering contributions to deep learning and computer vision He invented Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) (1988), DjVu Image Compression, Backpropagation Advances (LeNet-1); 2018 ACM Turing Award (alongside Geoffrey Hinton and Yoshua Bengio) Yann leCun was leading Facebook AI Research (FAIR) since 2013.  He is also a Silver Professor at NYU , continuing to teach and conduct research Here are some other notable recent departures from Meta's AI division: Soumith Chintala, the co-creator and lead of PyTorch, left Meta after 11 years with the company and nearly eight years leading the PyTorch project Chaya Nayak, Avi Verma, Ethan Knight, Rishabh Agarwal, Afroz Mohiuddin, Chi-Hao Wu, ... In October 2025, Meta laid off approximately 600 employees from its AI unit under Alexandr Wang's leadership, affecting the Facebook Artificial Intelligence Research (FAIR) team, product-related AI groups, and AI infrastructure teams. Wang stated the cuts would enable faster decision-making.​ The departures follow Meta's major reorganization after CEO Mark Zuckerberg acknowledged falling behind competitors like OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic In June 2025, Meta invested $14.3 billion in Scale AI and brought on Scale CEO Alexandr Wang to run the new Meta Superintelligence Labs division The company has restructured its AI division four times in six months, creating what insiders describe as chaos , with new talent frustrated by bureaucracy and existing teams seeing their scope limited

slides.title: Dr. Fei-Fei Li Interview Dr. Fei-Fei Li created
slides.text: Dr. Fei-Fei Li    Interview Dr. Fei-Fei Li created ImageNet dataset in 2012 She previously served as Chief AI Scientist at Google Cloud, Director of Stanford's AI Lab, and co-founded Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute ImageNet (15 Mln images across 22,000 concepts). Li believes that World Models, spatial intelligence (understanding 3D worlds) is as important as language intelligence She founded World Labs in 2024 to develop world models that can create, reason about, and interact with 3D spaces - critical for robotics, embodied AI, and human augmentation World Labs just launched Marble ( https://marble.worldlabs.ai ) - allowing users to generate and explore fully navigable 3D worlds from text or image prompts. Applications include: Virtual production for films (cutting production time by 40x) Game development Robotics simulation and training Design and architecture Even psychological research for therapy scenarios Li notes we're far from achieving AGI, current AI can't perform tasks a toddler can do Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute (HAI, founded in 2018) - interdisciplinary research, education, policy work, AI governance In 2015-2016, tech companies avoided using the term "AI" because it was considered a "dirty word" - now every company is an AI company Advice for young talent: Li encourages intellectual fearlessness and focusing on passion, mission alignment, and team quality rather than overanalyzing every aspect of job decisions Every person has a role in AI, whether as creators using it as a tool, citizens participating in governance, or workers being augmented by it Lenny Rachitsky                                Dr. Fei-Fei Li https://www.lennysnewsletter.com

slides.title: China "Involution" Strategy China "Involution" Strategy https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7NwxzQmfTRg China
slides.text: China "Involution" Strategy China "Involution" Strategy https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7NwxzQmfTRg China is rapidly executing a trillion-dollar strategy to dominate key technology sectors including low-orbit satellites, humanoid robots, and commercial rockets The “Involution” Playbook - 4-step pattern Local governments pour resources into favored sectors (loans, cheap land, utilities) Massive waves of entrepreneurs enter, creating extreme market competition Only the most efficient and innovative survive—heavily subsidized by the state Victors expand globally and undercut Western rivals on price Historically proven to work: rare earth metals, drones, solar panels, electric vehicles, ... Satellites - at least four major Chinese initiatives are building large constellations to rival SpaceX's Starlink; Plans to launch 20,000+ satellites by the end of this decade, Rockets - 40 Chinese commercial launch companies are competing, many working on reusable technologies like SpaceX; Five have already deployed satellites Humanoid Robots - 60 out of the world’s 160 humanoid robot companies. Double the US count. Chinese firms control much of the global parts supply chain, enabling them to build robot arms at half the cost of American competitors; Provinces are constructing dedicated robot industrial parks By 2026, Chinese humanoid robots are expected to flood global markets at unbeatable prices. By 2027, China may establish irreversible supply chain control in strategic industries. State-driven duplication and competition result in many failures—but even limited success ensures global dominance in targeted sectors

slides.text: Elon Musk & Jensen Huang Interview Elon Musk and NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang interview: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1FT-r16CEC4 Creation vs. Disruption, true creation, filling voids with new possibilities Humanoid Robots - the biggest product industry ever AI and robotics to boost productivity and eliminating poverty globally Work will become optional (in 10-20 years). Jensen Huang explains the evolution from retrieval-based computing (static content) to generative computing (dynamic, context-driven outputs), creating demand for "AI factories" that generate unique software and data in real time Just 6 years ago most compute was CPU based, now it is mostly GPU based (accelerated computing) Robotics. Omniverse platform to train robots in simulated environment AI in Space - possible in 5 years Musk reveals the launch of a 500-megawatt data center project in partnership with NVIDIA and Saudi Arabia's Humain company AWS is also participating Saudi partnerships will also involve new supercomputers simulating quantum computing for breakthroughs in science and error correction

slides.title: AI Updates - 6 Gino Wickman Interviewed by
slides.text: AI Updates - 6 Gino Wickman Interviewed by Joe Polish Entrepreneurship, business systems, personal growth, and finding peace after success - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nos1pigdUaU Two hour interview. True entrepreneurship requires specific innate traits and demands extreme sacrifice. Build the right systems and team to create freedom. Success alone won't bring fulfillment—you must do inner work to release trauma, love yourself, and find peace. The journey is everything; there is no final destination AI Agency - How to Survive the AI Bubble https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=amAYKfRL8FI Focus on small-to-medium businesses (SMBs) which are more agile and see 10-15% higher success rates than enterprises. Smaller companies can rebuild systems from scratch without legacy constraints Obsess Over ROI : Niche down to collect performance data from previous clients and provide concrete ROI estimates in sales calls Shift to Optimizer Role : Successful AI projects require 12-18 months of constant optimization, not set-and-forget deployment. Focus on iterative feedback loops, prompt adjustments, long-term refinement Become AI Transformation Partner : Offer education and training alongside development, as this provides easiest ROI. Lead with AI literacy audits, workshops, and courses before moving into custom development. Default to Retainers : Build essential systems that become critical to operations, ensuring recurring revenue even during economic downturns. This protects against sudden budget cuts if the bubble deflates.

slides.title: 10 Metatrends That Will Define Your Future 10
slides.text: 10 Metatrends That Will Define Your Future 10 Metatrends That Will Define Your Future - by Peter H. Diamandis The speed of exponential tech is accelerating , and these technologies are converging and reinventing everything in their path. There will be much change, but that change will uplift humanity & create Abundance The next decade (2025 to 2035) represents the most transformative period in human history. A Metatrend is the unstoppable, long-term transformation of an industry or domain—propelled by the convergence of multiple exponential technologies. It systematically digitizes, dematerializes, demonetizes, and democratizes the field, reshaping it at an accelerating pace and unlocking entirely new possibilities. Here are 10 Metatrends: Abundance: Food, Energy, Education AI & Quantum Humanoid Robotics & Autonomous Systems Longevity, Medicine & Biotechnology Digital Currencies, Crypto & DeFi Robotaxis, Flying Cars & Drones Networks & Sensors Digital Manufacturing Metaverse and XR Space Exploration AI enhances every other technology, robotics enables space exploration, quantum computing accelerates drug discovery, and networks create the data layer that makes everything smarter. This is exponential multiplication: a 'Cambrian Explosion' of creative genius solving problems at the speed of digital superintelligence Exponential technologies will solve humanity’s greatest challenges faster than new problems emerge. By 2035, food, energy, and education will be democratized at scale through autonomous systems and AI. AI evolves from a tool to the fundamental substrate of civilization itself. Every person will deploy personalized swarms of AI agents, scientific discovery will become autonomous and continuous, and quantum-AI systems will solve previously intractable problems. Millions and then billions humanoid robots will integrate into daily life by 2035, handling 80% of household chores, providing 24/7 eldercare, and working in extreme environments including off-world settlements Medicine shifts from reactive to anticipatory and preventive, with aging becoming optional rather than inevitable The pattern of expensive-to-free is unfolding simultaneously across every Metatrend. Gene sequencing has dropped from $100 million to just $200. Advanced AI systems are now free to billions. Soon, longevity therapies, space access, and personalized education will follow. Each Metatrend carries profound dark sides that demand proactive governance: from AI alignment challenges and job displacement, to privacy erosion and new forms of inequality.
